name: Destructo-Bot: releasing the bot restores the built pet's action bar (#9991)
contract: Build: Destructo-Bot 804673 summons puppet 50300 that the Tinker possesses; PossessSpellInitialize replaces the
pet bar with the bot's. #9991 reports that with a Mechano-Bear 803405 (60671) out, the pet bar stayed empty after
the bot ended, so the bear could not be commanded until rebuilt. Unit::RemoveCharmedBy sent the empty control bar
(SMSG_PET_SPELLS 0x179 with a null guid) because the bot is not the owner's first controlled unit, and the bot's
SetMinion release never re-sent the bar because the bear keeps UNIT_FIELD_SUMMON. Expected: after the bot
self-destructs (802176) the bear is still out and the latest SMSG_PET_SPELLS names a unit again (its low guid
word is non-zero) instead of the cleared bar.
The bar is also re-sent after the puppet despawn settles: the client's possession teardown clears the control
bar when the possessed unit is destroyed, so the delayed packet must land after it. A self-destruct therefore
produces two restored-bar packets (the immediate one and the delayed one).

steps.label: Let the pet spell packets settle
SETUP: the bear's bar reaches the client
The build spell possesses its Destructo-Bot
SETUP: the build aura is on the Tinker
Pet bar packets before the bot self-destructs
The Build: Destructo-Bot aura ends with the bot
Let the pet spell packets settle
The restored bar is sent again after the possession teardown
The bear's bar is restored instead of cleared
